name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Cotton Candy
description: Sweeten your high with Double-Stacked Cotton Candy BITEZ. These dual-layer gummies swirl sweet pink vanilla with tangy blue raspberry for a fluffy, carnival-inspired flavor that brings the classic cotton candy experience to every chewy bite. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A sugary classic with a BITEZ-sized upgrade.
